init_SpotSkillManager: create a SpotSkillManager instance to initialize the Spot robot skill interface
run_opencabinet: run the opencabinet skill to open the left or right cabinet door on Spot
test_nav_waypoint: test navigation to a named waypoint using the SpotSkillManager nav method
pick_object_by_name: pick a named object like ball_plush using the SpotSkillManager pick method
place_object_at_target: place a held object at a named waypoint using the SpotSkillManager place method
